audit_items.proof_trace: BlobRPCMinValidSlot uses DenebForkEpoch instead of FuluForkEpoch as the base epoch for minimum slot calculation. After currentEpoch >= FuluForkEpoch + MinEpochsForBlobsSidecarsRequest, blobs should be fully deprecated, but the function still allows requests back to DenebForkEpoch, violating the deprecation invariant.
audit_items.attack_scenario: After Fulu fork + retention period, attacker sends P2P blob_sidecars_by_root requests for slots in range [FuluForkEpoch, FuluForkEpoch + MinEpochsForBlobsSidecarsRequest]. Node incorrectly serves these blobs because minReqSlot uses DenebForkEpoch (older) instead of FuluForkEpoch.
